why.source: The source's id: lowercase letters and digits. This file is sources/<source>.json, and the source's API is read from <SOURCE>_API_BASE_URL and <SOURCE>_API_TOKEN (the id in upper case).
why.siteId: The id the source addresses the site by. The source must list it as a destination of the workspace.
why.workspaceId: Null until the source's workspace the site receives from is known. Nothing can be received before.
why.release: How the source names a release to a Git-published site: the capability to request, the contract of what it releases, and the destination kind. Take them from the source's API documentation.
why.locales: The languages the site publishes. A release in any other language is refused.
why.contentDocumentFingerprint: sha256 of the ContentDocument@1 JSON Schema the site renders against. The value shipped here is the sha256 of nothing: it matches no schema, so every release is refused until it is replaced.
why.acceptedEngineShas: "any" accepts and records the engine of each release. A list accepts only engines that were reviewed.
why.releasesDir: Where received releases land, as <releasesDir>/<slug>/. Each source has its own folder.
